components.license: NetCDF-style permissive PnetCDF license AND MIT AND Unicode data notice (embedded utf8proc)
components.selected_profile: Production C API with MPI-IO, CDF-1 classic, CDF-2 64-bit offset, CDF-5 64-bit data; C++/Fortran/GIO/ADIOS/netCDF4/burst/subfiling disabled
components.availability: compiled C99 static target; original and trimmed sources verified with real one-rank MPI-IO CDF-1/2/5 roundtrip; multi-rank execution not verified
dependencies: External MPI C implementation with MPI-IO; not bundled
notes: CDF-5 is the 64-bit data format selected by NC_64BIT_DATA, with CDF\005 magic, including NC_INT64/NC_UINT64. It is not an HDF5-backed format or a separate netCDF library version.
Production public header is generated by configure from pnetcdf.h.in in the build/install include directory. The template contains all C API names; MPI headers and host ABI are not vendored.
The same MPI installation must supply compile-time types and runtime. Collective operations and request lifetimes need explicit communicator ownership in LMX wrappers.
The standalone portable CMake adapter requires a POSIX configure/make environment and an m4 build tool. No source fetching or regeneration from the internet.
A guarded source-view edit removes a semantically empty object/function pointer comparison from ncmpi_inq_libvers; version objects and public ABI remain intact.
The retained CDF roundtrip source supports arbitrary rank count; one-rank execution is available here, multi-rank execution is separately gated and must not be inferred.

Two upstream-declared ubyte attribute aliases missing from the archive are supplied by src/ubyte_aliases.c as direct calls to uchar implementations; all 915 ncmpi declarations now have linkable definitions.
PNETCDF_RELAX_COORD_BOUND=1 and PNETCDF_ERANGE_FILL=1; LMX_PNETCDF_INSTALL_PREFIX exports the generated prefix and lmx_pnetcdf_build is the ExternalProject dependency.

The adapter uses retained release configure with --disable-maintainer-mode. Unused GPL Autoconf Archive ax_* macro sources are omitted; their exception applies to configure output, not raw macro redistribution. Numeric-conversion M4 inputs remain.
